params.body:
The owner's agents can now read this app on a B1 mandate, the way they read the Stocklist platform: the app serves its own tools on `GET /api/control/tools` and checks the mandate and the request signature itself.

## What changes

- `App\Control\ReadMandate`: the mandate must be signed by one of the owner's keys, for layer B1, and cover `glk.read` on `glk:transferor`. The request must be signed by the agent the mandate names, be fresh, and be used only once. Both are checked against the DID document. These are the Stocklist platform's checks, adapted for this app (`config/control.php`).
- `App\Control\Reads`, five tools:
  - `health`: the Elixir report from the inside, plus the last site sync with its reason. Error lines are left out; only their count stays.
  - `bouwsoft`: whether the app key is set, whether a connection is stored, until when the token holds, and what is missing.
  - `sites`: the active sites with their source and the number of worksheet lines in 30 days.
  - `sites_preview`: the site sync in its dry run, naming the codes it would add, update and switch off.
  - `worksheets`: counts per day, status, language and missing field.
  No tool names a worker or returns audio or a token.
- `sites:sync` keeps the outcome of its last real run, with the reason when it fails (`SyncSites::LAST`). Until now the scheduler only knew that it had failed.
- `SiteSync` names the sites it changes, so a dry run can be checked.
- `ElixirController::report()` is the report without the token check. This file is a copy of the shared elixir-laravel module and now differs from it in that one method.

## Why

Since early October Elixir has seen one scheduled job, `sites:sync`, fail on every run, and from outside nobody can tell why. With these tools a session can read the reason, the state of the Bouwsoft connection and a dry run of the sync, without SSH and without anybody's name leaving the app.

## Test

`tests/Feature/ControlReadTest.php` checks every refusal of the door, the one-time nonce, each tool, and that the preview changes nothing. Full suite: 167/167, pint clean.

## After merge

This only works once the matching Portal change (`glk:transferor`, kind `glk.read`) and the portal-cli change (`glk_*` tools) are merged. Then the owner switches the system on in the project settings and admits reading for 30 days.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01EWy1829KawX3VL5LnrkdXD
params.title: A read door for the owner's agents: health, Bouwsoft, sites, sync preview, worksheets
